stimulus.text: The Cantino planisphere, a Portuguese world map drawn in 1502. It shows the Atlantic Ocean with Africa in the center, Europe at the top, and the coast of South America and the Caribbean on the left. A north-south line runs through the Atlantic, and small flags mark the coasts claimed by Portugal and Spain.
stimulus.source_note: Cantino planisphere, 1502, public domain; Biblioteca Estense, Modena.

parts.prompt: Identify one feature shown on the map.
Explain what the map shows about European knowledge of the world in 1502.
Explain one way the map reflects rivalry between Spain and Portugal.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
